source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.5 with Fig. 9.16 and Examples 9.4 and 9.5 (PDF 202-204).

blocks.text: Fig. 9.16 mein do parallel (mutawazi) plates hain jin par ulte charges hain; yeh plates apne darmiyan uniform electric field banati hain.

blocks.alt: Do horizontal (ufuqi) plates: oopar B (+), neeche A (-), faasla d. Magenta lines seedhi neeche. Darmiyan chhota charge +q, hara teer F oopar aur surkh teer qE neeche.
blocks.caption: Figure 9.16 (kitab ki Figure 9.16 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Field +q ko neeche (A ki taraf) dhakelti hai: force qE. Charge ko A se B tak barabar speed (raftar) se le jane ke liye barabar aur ulti force F = qE oopar lagani parti hai; yahi kaam charge ki potential energy barhata hai.

Is uniform field mein ek positive (musbat) charge q ko azaad chhor dein to woh plate B se A ki taraf chalega aur kinetic energy (K.E.) hasil karega. Agar ise A se B le jana ho to field ke khilaf chalane ke liye bahar se force lagani paregi, aur charge potential energy (P.E.) hasil karega. Condition (shart) yeh rakhte hain ke charge A se B tak electrostatic equilibrium (barabari ki halat) mein rahe, yani uniform (ek jaisa) velocity se chale. Iske liye raste ke har point par qE ke barabar aur ulti force F lagate hain. Field ke khilaf bahar wali force jo kaam karti hai, woh charge ki electrical potential energy barha deti hai.
Maan lein W_AB woh kaam hai jo force charge q ko equilibrium mein rakhte hue A se B tak le jane mein karti hai. Phir potential energy mein tabdeeli ΔU = W_AB, yani:
Yahan U_A aur U_B points A aur B par potential energies hain.

Electric field ko describe karne ke liye potential difference ka idea (khayal) laate hain. Do points A aur B ka potential difference woh kaam hai jo ek unit positive charge ko equilibrium mein rakhte hue A se B tak le jane mein hota hai:
Yahan V_A aur V_B points A aur B par electric potentials hain. Potential energy ka farq aur potential ka farq aapas mein yun jure hain:
Yani potential difference = har unit charge ki potential energy ka farq.

blocks.title: Kya aap jaante hain? (Do You Know?)
blocks.text: ECG insaan ki skin (jild) ke points ke darmiyan woh “voltage” record karti hai jo dil ke electrical process (amal) se banta hai. Daurte hue li gayi ECG batati hai ke stress (dabao) mein dil kaisa kaam karta hai.
P.E. ki unit joule hai, is liye Eq. 9.17 se potential difference ki unit joule per coulomb hai. Ise volt kehte hain:
Yani do points ke darmiyan 1 volt ka potential difference tab hai jab 1 coulomb positive charge ko equilibrium mein rakhte hue ek point se doosre tak le jane mein 1 joule kaam ho.

Kisi ek point ka potential batane ke liye ek reference point chahiye jise zero potential dete hain; aam taur par yeh infinity (bohat door) par liya jata hai. Eq. 9.17 mein A ko infinity par lein aur V_A = 0 rakhein to B ka potential V_B = W_AB/q hoga. Aam taur par:

Yani kisi point ka electric potential woh kaam hai jo ek unit positive charge ko equilibrium mein rakhte hue infinity se us point tak lane mein hota hai. Is liye har point ka potential infinity ke muqable mein hota hai. Potential aur potential difference dono scalar hain, kyun ke W aur q dono scalar hain.

blocks.title: Ghaur karein (Point to ponder)
blocks.text: Electric appliances (bijli ki cheezein) chalate waqt rubber ke talwon (soles) wale joote pehnne ka mashwara kyun diya jata hai?
Electric field potential gradient ke taur par

Ab electric intensity aur potential difference ka relation (taalluq) nikalte hain. Fig. 9.16 dobara dekhein: plates ke darmiyan field uniform hai aur us ki qeemat E hai. A aur B ka potential difference:
Yahan W_AB = Fd = −qEd. Minus sign is liye ke charge ko equilibrium mein rakhne ke liye F ko qE ke ulat lagana parta hai. Is tarah Eq. 9.21:
Agar plates A aur B ka faasla bohat hi chhota Δd ho to Eq. 9.22 yun ban jati hai:

ΔV/Δd batata hai ke faasle ke saath potential kitni tezi se badalta hai; field line ke saath chalne par plates ka faasla Δd sab se kam hota hai, is liye yeh sab se zyada (maximum) rate hai. Ise potential gradient kehte hain. Yani electric intensity potential gradient ka negative (manfi) hai. Minus sign batata hai ke E ki direction (rukh) ghatte hue potential ki taraf hai (+ plate se − plate ki taraf).

blocks.title: Kya aap jaante hain?
blocks.text: Electroencephalography (EEG) mein brain (dimagh) ki electrical activity (sargarmi) se bane potential differences record kiye jate hain; in se abnormal behaviour (ghair-mamooli baratao) ki diagnosis (bimari ki pehchan) hoti hai. (Kitab ki tasveeron par "ECG" likha hai, magar alpha rhythm brain ki wave (lehar) hai, yani yeh EEG ki tasveerein hain.)
Eq. 9.23 se electric intensity ki unit volt/metre (V m⁻¹) hai, jo N C⁻¹ ke barabar hai:

blocks.text_alt: 1 volt/metre = 1 (joule/coulomb)/metre = 1 (newton × metre)/(metre × coulomb) = 1 newton/coulomb = 1 N C⁻¹

blocks.title: Example 9.4
blocks.problem: Do parallel metal (dhaat) ki plates 1.0 cm door hain aur 12 volt ki battery se jori hain. Un ke darmiyan electric field intensity nikalein.
steps: Diya gaya: ΔV = 12 V, Δd = 1.0 cm = 1 × 10⁻² m, E = ?

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki aakhri line mein 12 V ko "1×10 m" se divide kiya gaya hai; power −2 reh gayi hai. Sahi 1 × 10⁻² m hai (pehli line mein bhi yehi hai), aur jawab 1200 V m⁻¹ theek hai.

blocks.title: Example 9.5
blocks.problem: Do horizontal parallel metal ki plates 12 volt ki battery se jori hain. Negative plate se ek electron chhora jata hai. Positive plate tak pohanchte waqt us ki velocity nikalein. Electron ka mass = 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg, charge q = e = 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C.
steps: Electron negative plate se door dhakela jata hai aur positive plate ki taraf kheencha jata hai, is liye woh positive plate ki taraf tez hota (accelerate) jata hai. Jo P.E. woh khota hai woh K.E. ban jati hai.
P.E. ka nuqsan = K.E. ka faida: ΔV × e = ½ mv²
Qeematein: 12 V × 1.6 × 10⁻¹⁹ C = ½ × 9.1 × 10⁻³¹ kg × v²

blocks.prompt: Electric potential define karein aur sabit karein ke electric field intensity potential gradient ka negative hai (comprehensive question 9.1). 50 μC charge se 50 cm door potential nikalein (MCQ 9.5). Electric appliances chalate waqt rubber ke talwon wale joote kyun pehnne chahiyein (Point to ponder)?
blocks.explanation: Kisi point par potential = positive charge ko infinity se wahan lane mein har unit charge par kaam, V = W/q. Plates ke darmiyan W_AB = −qEd, is liye V_B − V_A = −Ed aur E = −ΔV/Δd, yani potential gradient ka negative. V = kq/r = (9 × 10⁹ × 50 × 10⁻⁶)/0.5 = 9 × 10⁵ V: option (c). Rubber insulator hai: yeh body (jism) se zameen tak current ka raasta poora nahi hone deta, is liye agar live taar chhu bhi jaye to body se bohat kam ya koi current nahi guzarta.

blocks.text: Mukhtasar khulasa

items: Charge q ko E ke khilaf A se B uniform velocity se le jana: ΔU = W_AB (9.16).
Potential difference ΔV = W_AB/q = ΔU/q (9.17); ΔU = qΔV (9.18); 1 V = 1 J C⁻¹ (9.19); potential V = W/q, infinity se (9.20); dono scalar.
E = −ΔV/Δd (9.23): field potential gradient ka negative, ghatte potential ki taraf; V m⁻¹ = N C⁻¹.
Examples: 1200 V m⁻¹; electron 2.1 × 10⁶ m s⁻¹.
